com.hkust.marketplace.controllers.admin.AdminRatingsPane
All Implemented Interfaces:
javafx.css.Styleable, javafx.event.EventTarget
final class AdminRatingsPane extends javafx.scene.layout.VBox
Task 3.8 – Seller Ratings Overview.

Lists every rating (including hidden ones) with seller/buyer, score, comment, date and visibility. Filters cover user, score and date range. Hiding a review removes it from the public seller average; unhiding restores it.
